title: Persistent Pain After Laparoscopic Inguinal Hernia Repair
brief_summary: Describe and characterizes laparoscopic postherniotomy patients with persistent moderate/severe pain affecting every day activities - including detailed quantitative sensory assessment
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male patients \> 18 yrs
* No sign of hernia recurrence
* Chronic groin pain lasting more than 3 months
* Moderate/severe pain related impairment of everyday activities

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other causes of persistent pain in groin region (hip, other surgical procedures)
* Drug or alcohol abuse
* Conflicting neurological disorders
study_population: Patients with persistent pain after laparoscpic inguinal hernia repair
